project.name: ShipFlow Plugin Archetype
project.description:
Maven archetype that scaffolds a new ShipFlow plugin project: a pom.xml pre-wired with a <scope>provided</scope> dependency on shipflow-plugin-api, plus one sample class implementing RiskCalculatorPlugin. Generate a new plugin project with:
mvn archetype:generate \ -DarchetypeGroupId=com.github.farzadsedaghatbin.shipflow \ -DarchetypeArtifactId=shipflow-plugin-archetype \ -DarchetypeVersion=1.0.0 \ -DgroupId=com.example \ -DartifactId=my-shipflow-plugin \ -DinteractiveMode=false
See plugin-sdk/README.md for the full workflow (this archetype does NOT enable dynamic runtime JAR loading — the generated project is compiled into the ShipFlow backend build as a regular Maven dependency; see the "Deployment" section of that README).
